about: GMS (Heroic) cube numbers that Nexon doesn't publish for GMS. Line odds come from cube_lines_kms.json (Nexon Korea's official tables); 'kmsLines' names the KMS cube whose lines each GMS cube is taken to share. tierUp is keyed by the tier being left: rare = Rare->Epic, epic = Epic->Unique, unique = Unique->Legendary.

tierUpNote: GMS tier-up rates aren't published (KMS's official ones are far lower: Red 6 / 1.8 / 0.3%). 'community' = the '[Post-Reboot] Cubing rates v170+' sheet, tab 'Non-(D)MT - All Sources' (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1od_hep5Y6x2ljfrh4M8zj5RwlpgYDRn5uTymx4iLPyw/pubhtml), counts read 2026-10-04 as [tier-ups, cubes used]. It was recorded with Red/Black cubes before GMS's v.239 cube revamp. Glowing and Bright are rounded to the precision their samples support (measured 14.10 / 6.06 / 2.45% and 16.83 / 11.17 / 4.74%, each within one standard error of the rounded value). Miracle Time doubles Glowing and Bright tier-up rates only. 2-rank jumps are ignored.

fee.formula: per cube: constant x item level^2, constant by item level
fee.source: community formula (e.g. 392,000 mesos per cube at Lv. 140); not yet checked against the in-game cube window

statBump.source: maplestorywiki.net/w/Potential: GMS/TMS stat values go up one step from Lv. 151. In game (Oct 2026): Ren's Lv. 160 Challenger sword shows Unique ATT 7% (KMS table 6%). KMS's own tables add the step only from Lv. 201, so it is applied here for Lv. 151-200.
